product_family: End-to-end computer vision platform: dataset labeling/management (including Roboflow Universe, a public community dataset/model repository), model training and fine-tuning, and Roboflow Inference (open-source deployment runtime for cloud, edge, VPC, or air-gapped/on-prem). Offered as Public (free), Core (paid, private), and Enterprise tiers.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: SOC II Type 2 Compliant, PCI compliant with Self-Assessment Questionnaire A and Attestation of Compliance, HIPAA Compliant.

certifications.name: HIPAA (BAA available)
certifications.proof_quote: HIPAA Compliant" infrastructure with the ability to execute Business Associate Agreements (BAAs); trust center (security.roboflow.com) also lists HIPAA under its Compliance section. Pricing page confirms this is an Enterprise-tier feature: "HIPAA compliance & BAA" listed only under the Enterprise plan.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: PCI compliant with Self-Assessment Questionnaire A and Attestation of Compliance

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence: the vendor's own SafeBase trust center (security.roboflow.com) lists only SOC 2 and HIPAA under Compliance; ISO 27001 does not appear anywhere on the trust center, enterprise docs, or licensing pages. Some third-party aggregator sites claim Roboflow holds ISO 27001/27701, but this could not be confirmed on any roboflow.com or docs.roboflow.com page and is likely conflated with a different vendor.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture)
certifications.proof_quote: European General Data Protection Regulation (the "GDPR") ... If you reside in the Designated Countries, you have a number of important rights ... we will use European Commission-approved Standard Contractual Clauses as a legal mechanism for data transfers from the Designated Countries (EU, EEA, UK, and Switzerland).

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on vendor domain (not listed on trust center, enterprise, or licensing pages).

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on vendor domain.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on vendor domain. Third-party sources claim FedRAMP compliance but this is not corroborated anywhere on roboflow.com, docs.roboflow.com, or the SafeBase trust center.

privacy.ai_training_note: Enterprise Terms grant Roboflow the right to "collect and analyze data ... relating to the provision, use and performance of various aspects of the Services (including information concerning Customer Data and data derived therefrom)" to improve the Services, and to disclose such data "solely in aggregate or other de-identified form." This is a service-improvement/analytics clause, not an explicit statement that raw customer images are used to train foundation/shared models. Separately, for AI/LLM features, enterprise docs state "All AI and LLM requests made through Roboflow ... are routed with zero data retention enforced at the gateway level." On the free Public tier, data and trained models are explicitly public/open source on Roboflow Universe by design; Core and Enterprise tiers keep data private. No explicit customer-data-training opt-out toggle was found on a vendor page, so this remains unclear rather than confirmed true or false.
privacy.data_region: Processes data inside and outside the United States; relies on EU Commission-approved Standard Contractual Clauses for transfers from the EU/EEA/UK/Switzerland ("Designated Countries"). No dedicated EU-only or regional data residency option was found on a vendor page outside of self-hosted/on-prem/VPC deployment for Enterprise customers.

security.name: Encryption in transit and at rest
security.value: All data is encrypted in transit and at rest, with SSL transport receiving a grade A+ rating (Qualys).

security.name: Self-hosted / on-prem / air-gapped deployment
security.value: Enterprise tier supports deploying models offline, in customer VPC, on-premise, air-gapped, and via Kubernetes; Roboflow Inference is also available as an open-source, self-hostable runtime for all tiers.

security.name: SSO / access controls
security.value: Enterprise plan adds SSO, scoped API keys, usage audit logs, and SIEM export capability.

security.name: AI/LLM gateway data retention
security.value: AI and LLM requests routed through Roboflow are handled with zero data retention enforced at the gateway level.

security.name: Trust center security domains
security.value: SafeBase trust center publishes policy/control categories including Access Control, Data Backups, Data Erasure, Bot Detection, Code Analysis, Disk Encryption, Endpoint Detection & Response, DNSSEC, Firewall, VPC, and a Pentest Report and Network Diagram (documents may require an access request).

products.name: Roboflow Public (free)
products.data_scope: Images, annotations, and trained models are public/open source on Roboflow Universe by default.
products.notes: No self-hosting, community support only, 2 users. Not suitable for sensitive or proprietary data.

products.name: Roboflow Core
products.notes: Adds self-hosted inference server option; no commercial model license included for edge deployment.

products.name: Roboflow Enterprise
products.data_scope: Private data and models; supports on-prem/VPC/air-gapped deployment.
products.notes: Only tier with HIPAA compliance & BAA, custom MSA & DPA, SSO, audit logs, SIEM export, and commercial model license for edge deployment. SOC 2 Type II and PCI SAQ A claims are made at the company/infrastructure level and referenced specifically in this enterprise documentation.

products.name: Roboflow Inference
products.data_scope: Runs locally / in customer infrastructure; no customer data necessarily transits Roboflow's cloud.
products.notes: pip-installable open-source server for running models in customer-controlled environments.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: free Public tier (public data only) -> Core paid tier (private data, self-hosted inference) -> custom-priced Enterprise (on-prem/VPC/air-gapped, HIPAA/BAA, custom DPA, SSO, SIEM).
compare.data_residency: US-based company; processes data inside and outside the US using Standard Contractual Clauses for EU/UK/Switzerland transfers. No named EU-only hosting region found on a vendor page; Enterprise customers can deploy fully within their own cloud/VPC/on-prem for data residency control.

flags: PCI compliance is at the SAQ A / Attestation of Compliance self-assessment level (typical for vendors that don't directly handle cardholder data via a third-party processor), not a full PCI DSS Level 1 QSA audit. It should be shown as 'PCI DSS (SAQ A)', not unqualified 'PCI DSS certified'.

HIPAA/BAA capability is documented as an Enterprise-tier feature on the pricing page ('HIPAA compliance & BAA' listed only under Enterprise); it is not automatically available on Public or Core plans, so blanket HIPAA compliance should not be implied across all tiers.

Third-party aggregator sites and other web summaries claim Roboflow holds ISO 27001, ISO 27701, FedRAMP, and CSA STAR, but none of these appear on the vendor's own trust center (security.roboflow.com), enterprise docs, or licensing pages; these claims may be conflated with a different company.

AI-training posture on customer data is unclear: Enterprise Terms permit Roboflow to use aggregate/de-identified customer-derived data for service improvement, which is broader than a strict 'no training on customer data' guarantee, but there is no evidence raw customer images are used to train shared/foundation models. No explicit training opt-out control was found.
Free 'Public' tier data and trained models are open/public on Roboflow Universe by design; this is a meaningful product-tier distinction for prospective users handling sensitive imagery.

SOC 2 report Type (I vs II) is explicitly stated only on the docs.roboflow.com enterprise page ('SOC II Type 2 Compliant'); the SafeBase trust center itself just says 'SOC 2' without specifying the type on the publicly visible portion of the page.
